texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.If you think you would be a good fit, te: I deploy AI into messy real-world environments every day: I run a production multi-machine Claude agent fleet with cross-machine consensus, persistent memory, RAG over a 10-year knowledge base, MCP connectors and published reliability evals (0/17 high-risk actions slipped past the human approval gate in recorded runs). I ship agent systems end-to-end and can sit in front of a customer or a regulator: 15+ years founder/BD background, including structuring stablecoin frameworks with banks and governments in SE Asia. 110 public repos (claw-consensus, verbatim-citation-gate), 50+ published items, 136 citations, h-index 7. OpenEvidence's mission - trustworthy AI answers in a domain where fabrication is unacceptable - is exactly the problem my citation-verification work attacks: verbatim-citation-gate catches fabricated RAG citations before they reach the user. US O-1 active, based in Palo Alto, available immediately.
